learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to create content for modern communication media.
Students have in-depth knowledge of methods for digital acquisition, processing, storage, and transmission of multimedia data, especially auditory and visual media.
Students can design media and identify, formulate, and solve practical problems.

syllabus_topics: Digitization of audio, images, and video

assessment_methods.method: Weekly exercise assignments (at least 50% of points)
Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution of at least two of these assignments. Grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science degree program.
